note: Rules-enforced Pro deck (server hero appa), mirrored from unmatched.cards deck jw9q "Appa" by JBentz (https://unmatched.cards/decks/jw9q), version 6Dz_TJqPO, updated 2026-08-23. Card titles, types, values, boosts and quantities are the author's, and are VERIFIED card by card against the author's own finished card renders — the complete 14-file PNG set JBentz posted in the unbrewed Discord #pro-deck-request thread on 2026-08-23 — and against the engine's data/heroes/appa.rules.ts (engine #522/#525). Where a printed card disagreed with the unmatched.cards payload the CARD WINS: "Sky Bison" is printed THE LAST SKY BISON, Air Nomads' DURING clause reads "shares all their zones with your fighter" (singular) rather than the payload's "your fighters", Team Avatar reads "shares a space with another fighter" rather than the payload's "a friendly fighter", and the hero ability is headed THE FIRST AIRBENDER. "PLay Fighting" keeps the payload's capital L (the printed card is set in all caps, so it neither confirms nor denies it) and the ability's "has a move value is 4" keeps the card's own grammar — art matching is keyed on the verbatim title, and typos are never "fixed" here. Card faces are the author's own renders, self-hosted in public/evergreen-decks/art/appa and drawn full-bleed via cardImage; every URL is repo-relative (malfurion/Ripley precedent) so the art resolves on localhost and preview builds. The payload's own imageUrl fields — uncredited third-party hotlinks — are deliberately NOT carried over. Also mirrored but not referenced by any UI surface yet: art/appa/hero-card.webp, the author's character-card render.
